cc:Work.dc:title: WallMounted - WallChiselHolder
cc:Work.dc:description:
Wall tool holder for chisels, files and similar tools
Created with Boxes.py (https://boxes.hackerspace-bamberg.de/) Command line: boxes WallChiselHolder --thickness 6 --burn 0.05 --h 150 --tooldiameter 40 --holediameter 25 --slot_width 8 --radius 3 --number 4 --reference 0 --labels 0 Command line short: boxes WallChiselHolder --thickness --burn --h --tooldiameter --holediameter --slot_width --radius --number --reference --labels
